consent.modal_title: Clinical AI Health Coach Disclosure & Consent
consent.intro: Disha AI is your personalized lifestyle, nutrition, and habit health coach.
consent.not_doctor: Disha is an artificial intelligence health coach, not a licensed medical doctor or clinical practitioner.
consent.no_prescription: Disha cannot diagnose diseases, alter doctor-prescribed medication dosages, or prescribe pharmaceuticals.
consent.emergency: If you experience chest pain, shortness of breath, or an acute emergency, dial 112 or 108 immediately.
consent.voice_processing: Audio is captured for speech-to-text processing solely to conduct this consultation session.
consent.checkbox: I understand Disha is an AI health coach and consent to voice consultation processing.

onboarding.stage_1_desc: Disha collects your health baseline naturally across chat and voice calls.
onboarding.stage_3_desc: Sleep patterns, work schedule, hydration, and movement.
onboarding.stage_4_desc: Nutrition preferences, target goals, and food habits.
onboarding.stage_5_desc: Validated coaching plan and tailored lifestyle adjustments.
onboarding.welcome_message:
Namaste {name}! I am Disha, your personal AI health coach. I provide grounded lifestyle, habit, and nutrition guidance. I am not a doctor and cannot diagnose medical emergencies.

How are you feeling today? Would you like to review today's nutrition plan or discuss your wellness goals?
